_comment: env.example/env.local: placeholder-only files, no real secrets (brief section 6). process.env: normal Next.js source code reading env vars by name, not a leaked secret value — real secrets live only in env.local, which is gitignored and never read/printed by Claude. SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: the variable NAME is referenced by server-only code (src/lib/supabase/admin.js) and documented as a placeholder in env.example — the real value is never written by Claude, only ever pasted by the user directly into env.local.
